controlled_linux_probe.scope: controlled Linux descriptor-inheritance mechanism; not a trace of the failed hosted runner

copied_player_isolation.controlled_linux_probe_source:
import errno, fcntl, json, os, platform, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
results=[]
for trial in range(16):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
        target=os.path.join(directory,'busybox')
        shutil.copy2('/bin/busybox',target)
        writable=os.open(target,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CLOEXEC)
        assert fcntl.fcntl(writable,fcntl.F_GETFD)&fcntl.FD_CLOEXEC
        ready_r,ready_w=os.pipe()
        go_r,go_w=os.pipe()
        child=os.fork()
        if child==0:
            os.close(ready_r);os.close(go_w)
            os.write(ready_w,b'1')
            os.read(go_r,1)
            os.execl('/bin/true','true')
        os.close(ready_w);os.close(go_r)
        assert os.read(ready_r,1)==b'1'
        os.close(writable)
        try:
            subprocess.run([target,'true'],check=True)
            raise AssertionError('inherited write descriptor did not block execution')
        except OSError as error:
            assert error.errno==errno.ETXTBSY,error
        os.write(go_w,b'1')
        assert os.waitpid(child,0)[1]==0
        subprocess.run([target,'true'],check=True)
        os.close(ready_r);os.close(go_w)
        results.append({'trial':trial,'parent_writer_closed':True,'child_writer_cloexec':True,'before_child_exec_errno':26,'after_child_exec_exit':0})
print(json.dumps({'host':platform.platform(),'python':platform.python_version(),'results':results,'scope':'controlled Linux descriptor-inheritance mechanism; not a trace of the failed hosted runner'},indent=2))
